notes: Group E (Agriculture & FW/DARE-ICAR, Fisheries/AH&D, Food Processing, Consumer Affairs/Food & PD, Rural Development + Land Resources, Panchayati Raj, Chemicals & Fertilizers + Pharmaceuticals). Political appointments (ministers/MoS) are sourced to the official Cabinet Secretariat 'List of Council of Ministers with Portfolios (as on 23.06.2026)' PDF (cabsec.gov.in) — the most authoritative available single source; no reshuffle was confirmed between then and the 2026-09-25 as-of date, though press coverage (The Week, 18 Sept 2026) speculated a reshuffle might follow PM Modi's 23-24 September 2026 'Chintan Shivir' meeting with ministers — nothing had been announced as of research time, so the 23.06.2026 list is used as-is. KNOWN GAPS / LOW-CONFIDENCE ITEMS: (1) Secretary, Department of Consumer Affairs — could not confirm a specific named, dated current holder (search returned conflicting/stale candidates); position intentionally omitted from output rather than guessed. (2) Secretary, Ministry of Panchayati Raj — same issue; omitted. (3) Secretary, Department of Fertilizers (Rajat Kumar Mishra) — single indirect source, not cross-checked against an official page; confidence low. (4) Chairman, Central Warehousing Corporation — Wikipedia names Ashutosh Agnihotri, but other 2025-26 reporting has him leaving FCI CMD for Addl. Secretary MoEFCC at end-2025, so this is likely stale; confidence low, flagged in the position's notes. (5) ICAR's institute count (~113 units) is from a Wikipedia figure last verified circa 2020 in the source I could reach — the real 2026 count is almost certainly different (ICAR periodically adds/merges institutes); needs a fresh ICAR annual report check. (6) Direct network access to several *.gov.in / *.nic.in domains (consumeraffairs.nic.in, panchayatiraj.gov.in, fert.nic.in, cacp.dacnet.nic.in) timed out or failed DNS resolution from this research environment; where a mirror, PIB release, or Wikipedia page existed I used that instead, otherwise the field is left low-confidence/blank rather than invented. (7) Six pharma/fertiliser CPSEs (HIL, HAL-Antibiotics, IDPL, Bengal Chemicals, KAPL, RDPL, FACT, BVFCL, MFL, HURL) are entered with structural facts (ownership, HQ, founding) but NO current CMD/MD holder — several (HAL-Antibiotics, IDPL in particular) have been financially sick or under closure/disinvestment review for years and I could not confirm current operating status or leadership; do not treat their presence here as confirmation they are fully operational. (8) MGNREGA's 2025 repeal and replacement by the Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act is a genuinely surprising, high-impact finding confirmed via the current Wikipedia infobox (citing PRS Legislative Research, which shows the bill passed both Houses 18 Dec 2025) — flagged here because it is easy to mistake for a hallucination; I could not find the President's assent date or in-force/commencement date, so 'established' on that entity notes the passage date only. (9) A number of missions/sub-schemes (SPMRM, DDU-GKY, PMAY-G, NSAP, DILRMP, RGSA, RKVY, Mega Food Park Scheme, PMFME, PMBJP, Rashtriya Gokul Mission, National Livestock Mission) are entered with structural facts recalled from general/background knowledge rather than a freshly fetched 2025-26 source this pass; marked confidence:low/medium and should be re-verified against official scheme pages before publication. (10) CDSCO is referenced only (owned by the health segment) per the ministry brief; NCDRC is referenced only (owned by the judiciary segment) via one relation. [Adversarial verification pass 2026-09-25: fixed a stale/unsourced Fertilizers-Secretary holder, flagged a live conflict on the AHD-Secretary holder, cleaned up a confused CWC-chair note, and confirmed/upgraded confidence on 8 other agency-head and secretary positions with fresh 2025-2026 sourcing. See top-level 'verification' block for details.]

entities.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
entities.description: The nodal ministry for crop agriculture policy, farmer income-support and credit schemes, agricultural research/education (via ICAR) and crop insurance; it runs PM-KISAN and PMFBY.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
aliases: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare (former name)
entities.description: Runs crop-husbandry policy, minimum support price operations liaison, seeds, fertiliser-use extension, farm credit, PM-KISAN and PMFBY; the larger of the ministry's two departments (DA&FW).
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Agricultural Research and Education
entities.description: The department that funds and directs India's agricultural research system; its Secretary is concurrently Director-General of ICAR, which the department administers.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
entities.description: Carved out of the Agriculture Ministry in 2019; covers fisheries development, livestock health and breeding, and the dairy cooperative sector (through NDDB).
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Fisheries
entities.description: Administers the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana and India's fisheries and aquaculture development, including the National Fisheries Development Board.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
entities.description: Runs national livestock-health, breed-improvement and dairy-development programmes (Rashtriya Gokul Mission, National Livestock Mission) and administers NDDB.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
entities.description: Promotes food-processing investment and infrastructure (mega food parks, cold chains) and runs the PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises scheme.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
entities.description: Umbrella ministry for consumer protection, weights/measures, standards (BIS), food procurement and the public distribution system; has two departments.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Consumer Affairs
entities.description: Administers the Consumer Protection Act 2019 (via CCPA and the consumer commissions), Legal Metrology, BIS standards and the National Test House.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Food and Public Distribution
entities.description: Runs foodgrain procurement, buffer-stock and the public distribution system through FCI, CWC and WDRA, and administers PMGKAY free-foodgrain distribution under the NFSA.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; National Food Security Act, 2013

entities.name: Ministry of Rural Development
entities.description: India's principal poverty-alleviation and rural-infrastructure ministry: rural roads (PMGSY), rural housing (PMAY-G), rural livelihoods (DAY-NRLM) and the rural employment guarantee (now VB-G RAM-G).
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Rural Development
entities.description: Runs DAY-NRLM, PMAY-Gramin, PMGSY (through NRIDA), the National Social Assistance Programme and the successor to MGNREGA.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Land Resources
entities.description: Runs land-records digitisation (DILRMP) and watershed/wasteland development programmes.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
entities.description: Nodal ministry for the three-tier rural local self-government system mandated by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment; runs the Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan for panchayat capacity-building.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961; Part IX, Constitution of India

entities.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
entities.description: Runs India's chemicals/petrochemicals industrial policy, the fertiliser subsidy system and pharmaceutical pricing/production policy across three departments.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals
entities.description: Administers chemicals/petrochemicals industry policy and the CIPET and IPFT training/research institutes.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Fertilizers
entities.description: Administers the fertiliser subsidy (Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme) and owns/oversees the central fertiliser PSUs.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Pharmaceuticals
entities.description: Regulates drug pricing (through NPPA), affordable-medicine retail (Jan Aushadhi, through BPPI) and pharma education/research (NIPERs); drug safety/licensing (CDSCO) sits with the Health Ministry instead.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Indian Council of Agricultural Research
entities.description: India's apex agricultural research body: a registered society running dozens of national institutes, national research centres, national bureaux and agricultural universities. Wikipedia (as of ~2020, not independently recounted this pass) listed roughly 113 constituent units — 4 deemed universities, 65 institutes, 15 national research centres, 6 national bureaux and 13 project directorates, plus 11 zonal Agricultural Technology Application Research Institutes (ATARIs); the current count needs a fresh ICAR annual-report check.
entities.legalBasis: Registered as a society under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 (1929); administered under DARE

stats.asOfNote: Wikipedia figure, circa 2020, not re-verified in this pass

entities.name: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
entities.description: Attached office of the Agriculture Department that recommends Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for major crops each season; advisory only — MSP is set by the Union Cabinet.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution (established as Agricultural Prices Commission, 1965; renamed 1985)

entities.name: National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India
entities.description: A national apex multi-state cooperative society (not a CPSE) that undertakes price-support procurement of pulses/oilseeds on the government's behalf and markets agricultural produce for farmer cooperatives.
entities.legalBasis: Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act, 2002

entities.name: National Seeds Corporation
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking that produces and distributes certified/foundation seed and multiplies breeder seed from ICAR institutes.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: State Farms Corporation of India
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking that runs government seed/demonstration farms and produces quality seed.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Small Farmers' Agribusiness Consortium
entities.description: Society that promotes Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs) and agribusiness venture-capital assistance for small and marginal farmers.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under DA&FW

entities.name: Directorate of Marketing and Inspection
entities.description: Subordinate office that grades and standardises agricultural produce (AGMARK) and advises on agricultural marketing infrastructure and regulation.
entities.legalBasis: Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act, 1937

entities.name: National Rainfed Area Authority
entities.description: Advisory body on rainfed-area development and watershed management, housed in NITI Aayog/the Agriculture Department.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India order

entities.name: National Institute of Plant Health Management
entities.description: Autonomous institute that trains extension officers and farmers in integrated pest management, plant quarantine and pesticide management.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under DA&FW

entities.name: Central Fertiliser Quality Control and Training Institute
entities.description: Subordinate office (with regional labs) that tests fertiliser quality and trains state fertiliser-inspection staff.
entities.legalBasis: Fertiliser (Control) Order, 1985

entities.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
entities.description: Direct income-support scheme paying eligible landholding farmer families ₹6,000/year in three instalments straight to their bank accounts via Aadhaar-seeded DBT.
entities.legalBasis: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs approval, February 2019

entities.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
entities.description: Government-subsidised crop-insurance scheme protecting farmers against yield losses from natural calamities, pests and disease; implemented through empanelled insurers including AIC.
entities.legalBasis: Cabinet approval, January 2016

entities.name: Agriculture Insurance Company of India
entities.description: Central public-sector general insurer, majority government-owned, that is the largest implementing insurer for PMFBY and other crop-insurance schemes.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking, promoted by GIC, NABARD and public-sector banks)

entities.name: National Dairy Development Board
entities.description: Statutory body (an Institution of National Importance) that promotes India's dairy cooperative structure ('Operation Flood'/Amul model) — production, procurement and marketing of milk.
entities.legalBasis: National Dairy Development Board Act, 1987

entities.name: National Fisheries Development Board
entities.description: Autonomous body under the Department of Fisheries that funds and coordinates fisheries and aquaculture development schemes, including under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Fisheries

entities.name: Coastal Aquaculture Authority
entities.description: Statutory regulator that registers and regulates coastal shrimp/fish farms to protect the coastal environment.
entities.legalBasis: Coastal Aquaculture Authority Act, 2005

entities.name: Central Institute of Fisheries, Nautical and Engineering Training
entities.description: Subordinate office that trains marine fishing crews and fisheries engineers.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India order

entities.name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission
entities.description: Flagship cattle/buffalo indigenous-breed development and conservation mission under the National Programme for Bovine Breeding and Dairy Development.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: National Livestock Mission
entities.description: Scheme for livestock development covering breed improvement, fodder development, and entrepreneurship in poultry/small ruminants/pigs.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management
entities.description: Institute of National Importance for food-technology education, entrepreneurship and R&D, with campuses at Kundli (Haryana) and Thanjavur (Tamil Nadu, the former IIFPT).
entities.legalBasis: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management Act, 2021

entities.name: Mega Food Park Scheme
entities.description: Scheme funding cluster-based food-processing infrastructure (mega food parks) linking farm produce to retail/export markets.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme
entities.description: Scheme supporting formalisation, credit access and branding for unorganised micro food-processing units, often on a one-district-one-product basis.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval (Atmanirbhar Bharat package)

entities.name: Food Corporation of India
entities.description: Statutory corporation that procures foodgrain (chiefly rice and wheat) at MSP, maintains buffer stocks for food security, and supplies grain to the public distribution system.
entities.legalBasis: Food Corporations Act, 1964

entities.name: Central Warehousing Corporation
entities.description: Statutory public warehousing corporation storing foodgrain and other commodities across India, working alongside State Warehousing Corporations.
entities.legalBasis: Warehousing Corporations Act, 1962

entities.name: Warehousing Development and Regulatory Authority
entities.description: Regulator that licenses warehouses and registers Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (NWRs), enabling farmers to pledge stored produce for credit.
entities.legalBasis: Warehousing (Development and Regulation) Act, 2007

entities.name: Bureau of Indian Standards
entities.description: India's national standards body: sets and certifies (ISI mark) product/service standards, hallmarks precious metals, and runs the Sathyabama-run product-certification and lab-testing systems.
entities.legalBasis: Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 2016

entities.name: National Test House
entities.description: Subordinate office providing third-party materials/product testing and calibration services, with regional laboratories, under the Department of Consumer Affairs.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India order

entities.name: Legal Metrology Division
entities.description: Central regulator for weights and measures (packaged-commodity declarations, weighing/measuring instrument approval); enforcement is largely by State Legal Metrology departments.
entities.legalBasis: Legal Metrology Act, 2009

entities.name: Central Consumer Protection Authority
entities.description: Regulator with powers to investigate and act against unfair trade practices, misleading/false advertising and violations of consumer rights, including recalls.
entities.legalBasis: Consumer Protection Act, 2019, Section 10

entities.name: Directorate of Sugar and Vegetable Oils
entities.description: Subordinate office that administers sugar-sector policy (cane pricing liaison, sugar-mill data, export/stock rules) within the Food & PD department.
entities.legalBasis: Essential Commodities Act, 1955 (sugar orders)

entities.name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
entities.description: Free-foodgrain scheme — 5 kg/person/month on top of NFSA entitlements — launched as COVID-19 relief in March 2020 and since folded into free (rather than subsidised) NFSA distribution, with the free-grain policy extended to December 2028.
entities.legalBasis: Cabinet approval, March 2020; extension Cabinet approvals through 2028; operates within the National Food Security Act, 2013 framework

entities.name: National Institute of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj
entities.description: Apex national training and research institute for rural development and panchayati raj functionaries, with a main campus in Hyderabad and centres in Guwahati and Delhi.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Ministry of Rural Development (established 1964 as National Institute of Community Development)

entities.name: DAY-NRLM (National Rural Livelihood Mission)
entities.description: Self-help-group-based poverty-alleviation mission mobilising rural women into SHGs for savings, credit and livelihood promotion; the World Bank-supported National Rural Economic Transformation Project (NRETP) is a sub-project deepening NRLM's livelihoods and financial-inclusion work in select states.
entities.legalBasis: Restructuring of the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana; renamed Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-NRLM in 2015

entities.name: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
aliases: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
entities.description: The rural employment-guarantee mission that replaced MGNREGA: raises the guaranteed-work entitlement from 100 to 125 days/year, revises Centre-State funding shares (60:40 generally, 90:10 for NE/Himalayan states), and adds steering committees and tech-based monitoring. The enabling Act was passed by both Houses on 18 December 2025, repealing the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005.
entities.legalBasis: Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (repeals the MGNREGA, 2005)
entities.established: 2025-12-18 (passed by Parliament; commencement date not independently confirmed)

entities.name: National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency
entities.description: Implementing agency for PMGSY (rural roads) and other rural-infrastructure programmes on behalf of the Department of Rural Development.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Ministry of Rural Development

entities.name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana
entities.description: Centrally sponsored scheme to give unconnected rural habitations all-weather road connectivity; now in its fourth phase (PMGSY-IV, covering smaller habitations and left-wing-extremism/aspirational districts), implemented through NRIDA.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, December 2000

entities.name: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission
entities.description: Mission clustering neighbouring villages into 'rurban' growth clusters with urban-grade infrastructure while preserving rural character.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
entities.description: Placement-linked skill-training scheme for rural youth from poor families, run under the NRLM umbrella.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin
entities.description: Rural housing scheme giving pucca houses with basic amenities to houseless/inadequately-housed rural families; the restructured successor to the Indira Awaas Yojana.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: National Social Assistance Programme
entities.description: Umbrella social-pension scheme for elderly, widowed and disabled people below the poverty line (old-age, widow and disability pensions, and a family-benefit grant), part-funded by the Centre and topped up by states.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, Article 41 (Directive Principles)

entities.name: Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme
entities.description: Programme to digitise land records, computerise registration and integrate them towards a conclusive land-titling system.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval (merger of NLRMP, 2008)

entities.name: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan
entities.description: Capacity-building scheme for Panchayati Raj Institutions covering training, e-governance (eGramSwaraj) and devolution support.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval

entities.name: Hindustan Insecticides Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking manufacturing technical-grade pesticides (originally DDT for malaria control) and agrochemicals, with plants in Kerala, Maharashtra and Punjab.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering and Technology
entities.description: National institute for skill development, education and R&D in plastics/petrochemicals engineering, with a large multi-city network of centres (40+ operational plus several under development).
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals (formerly Central Institute of Plastics Engineering and Technology)

entities.name: Institute of Pesticide Formulation Technology
entities.description: Institute researching and developing pesticide-formulation technology and providing testing/consultancy to the agrochemical industry.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals

entities.name: National Fertilizers Limited
entities.description: Navratna central public sector undertaking and India's second-largest urea producer, with plants at Nangal, Bathinda, Panipat and Vijaipur.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking (Government of India holds a majority stake) manufacturing urea and complex fertilisers plus industrial chemicals, headquartered in Mumbai.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (formed 1978 from the split of Fertilizer Corporation of India)

entities.name: Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore
entities.description: One of India's oldest fertiliser companies, a central public sector undertaking based in Kochi, Kerala, producing ammonium sulphate/factamfos fertilisers and caprolactam.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Brahmaputra Valley Fertilizer Corporation Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking operating urea plants at Namrup, Assam, serving the north-eastern fertiliser market.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Hindustan Urvarak and Rasayan Limited
entities.description: Joint-venture company (Coal India, NTPC, IOCL, FCIL and HFCL) reviving and operating revamped gas-based urea plants at Gorakhpur, Sindri and Barauni.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (joint-venture government undertaking)

entities.name: Madras Fertilizers Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking producing urea and complex fertilisers from a plant at Manali, Chennai; originally a joint venture with AMOCO and NIOC.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority
entities.description: Independent regulator that fixes/revises ceiling prices of scheduled (essential) medicines and monitors drug availability and prices nationally.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India Resolution, 29 August 1997

entities.name: NIPERs (National Institutes of Pharmaceutical Education and Research)
entities.description: Institutes of National Importance for pharmaceutical education/research; seven campuses — Mohali (1998, the original), Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Guwahati, Hajipur and Raebareli (2007-08).
entities.legalBasis: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Act, 1998

entities.name: Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India
entities.description: Implementing agency for the Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana, running Jan Aushadhi Kendra outlets that sell generic medicines at low prices; set up by pooling the pharma CPSEs.
entities.legalBasis: Registered society under the Department of Pharmaceuticals

entities.name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
entities.description: Scheme establishing dedicated outlets (Jan Aushadhi Kendras) selling quality generic medicines at prices well below branded equivalents, implemented through BPPI.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, 2008

entities.name: Hindustan Antibiotics Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking (Pimpri, Pune) manufacturing bulk drugs/antibiotics (notably penicillin); has faced prolonged financial stress, with disinvestment/closure repeatedly considered — current operational status not independently verified in this pass.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Indian Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking that was once India's largest bulk-drug maker; has been financially sick for years, with several units referred for closure/strategic disinvestment — current operational status not independently verified in this pass.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Bengal Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking (founded by P.C. Ray) producing pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals from plants in West Bengal.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Karnataka Antibiotics and Pharmaceuticals Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking manufacturing bulk drugs and formulations (notably anti-TB and anti-malarial drugs) from Bengaluru.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking, Government of Karnataka is a minority shareholder)

entities.name: Rajasthan Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited
entities.description: Central public sector undertaking manufacturing bulk drugs, based in Jaipur.
entities.legalBasis: Companies Act (Government of India undertaking)

entities.name: Directorate of Plant Protection, Quarantine and Storage
entities.description: Subordinate office regulating pesticide registration/quality, plant quarantine at ports of entry, and locust control, under the Insecticides Act and the Destructive Insects and Pests Act.
entities.legalBasis: Insecticides Act, 1968; Destructive Insects and Pests Act, 1914

entities.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
entities.description: Umbrella state-plan scheme giving states flexible funding to raise agriculture/allied-sector growth, planned through State Agriculture Plans.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India scheme approval, National Development Council

entities.name: Central Poultry Development Organisation
entities.description: Network of central poultry farms/training institutes (Central Poultry Development Organisation, four zonal units) that supply improved poultry germplasm and train poultry farmers.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India order

holder.notes: Confirmed via LIVE re-scrape of the official dahd.gov.in 'Who's Who' page on 2026-09-25 (as-of date): still lists 'Mr. Naresh Pal Gangwar, Secretary(AHD)'. NOTE A CONFLICTING SIGNAL: Gangwar was named Higher Education Secretary on 2026-07-24, reportedly reverted to continue as AHD Secretary by 2026-08-11 (per The BuckStopper/TheWire.in), and then a single press item (Elets eGov, 'Naresh Pal Gangwar appointed Rajasthan's new Principal Secretary IT', dated 2026-09-19, found via Google News search, original URL unresolved without JS) suggests he left for a Rajasthan state government posting -- 6 days before our as-of date. The official Union department website (a higher-priority source per the schema's quality bar) has not reflected any such change as of 2026-09-25. Keeping Gangwar as holder on the strength of the primary official source, but flagging this as an unresolved discrepancy that should be re-checked in the next pass.

positions.title: Secretary, Department of Fertilizers

holder.name: Arti Ahuja
holder.notes: CORRECTED: previous holder Rajat Kumar Mishra was unsourced. Press coverage (Elets eGov, 'Centre Appoints Arti Ahuja as Secretary, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers', 19 Sep 2026, found via Google News search -- original article URL could not be resolved without JS rendering) reports Ahuja's appointment on/around 2026-09-19. Ahuja previously held Secretary, Dept. of Chemicals & Petrochemicals (2022) and additional charge of Fertilizer Secretary (2022), so a Fertilizers posting fits her career track; D/o Chemicals & Petrochemicals is independently confirmed held by Tejveer Singh (chemicals.gov.in who's-who, live-checked 2026-09-25), so the two roles do not conflict. Single-source correction -- re-verify against fert.nic.in/PIB when reachable (DNS for fert.nic.in failed in this pass).
